biotools.summary: Squigualiser is a toolkit for interactive visualisation of raw nanopore signal data, enabling intuitive analysis of DNA and RNA sequencing data from Oxford Nanopore Technologies instruments. It provides a framework for efficient alignment of raw signal data and provides tools for signal browser views and pileup plots.
